Lung Cancer Cases in Ohio Counties (polygon).

Source: R/data.R
ohio_cancer.Rd

Data on lung cancer cases in counties in the state of Ohio in the 1960's through the 1980's.

Usage

ohio_cancer

Format

An sf object with POLYGON geometry on a WGS 84 / UTM zone 17N Projected coordinate reference system. The data has 528 rows, each corresponding to a county-gender-year combination and 7 columns:

  • fips: the fips code of the county.

  • county: the name of the county.

  • gender: a factor with two levels: "F" for female and "M" for male.

  • year: a factor with three levels: "68" for 1968, "78" for 1978, and "88" for 1988.

  • cases: the number of lung cancer cases reported for that particular county in that particular year for that particular gender.

  • population: the population size in the county for that particular year.

  • geometry: information giving the polygonal shapes of the counties in the state of Ohio.

Source

Data were modified from the ohio_lung data set in the geodaData R package.
